# ADDitude Magazine

> > A comprehensive resource for ADHD and learning disability information, support, and professional services directory.

ADDitude Magazine provides evidence-based guidance on ADHD management, treatment options, and educational resources. The site maintains a curated directory connecting individuals with qualified professionals including coaches, doctors, therapists, and specialized schools across the United States.

## Key Topics

- ADHD
- Learning Disabilities
- ADHD Coaches
- Treatment Professionals
- Therapists and Psychologists
- Educational Resources
- Professional Organizers
- Camps and Programs
- ADHD Schools
- Developmental Reinforcement Theory
- Focus Path
- ADDitude Magazine

## ADHD & Learning Disabilities Directory

- [The ADHD and Learning Disabilities Directory: ADD Coaches, Organizers, Doctors, Schools, Camps](https://directory.additudemag.com): Main ADHD/LD resource directory for finding coaches, doctors, schools, and support services
- [ADHD Directory: Attention Deficit Doctors, Coaches, Products, Professionals](https://directory.additudemag.com/listing): ADHD directory listing page for professionals, doctors, coaches, and mental health resources

## Business & Professional Services

- [ADHD Product and Services Directory: List Your Business | Attention Deficit Disorder Resources](https://directory.additudemag.com/advertise.php): Business listing submission page for ADHD coaches, therapists, and service providers
